# Yesode — Engineering Business Forward

> Yesode (YESODE CONSULTORIA E SERVIÇOS DE TECNOLOGIA LTDA, CNPJ 53.649.336/0001-38) is a Brazilian enterprise-first software engineering, systems architecture, and AI automation consultancy operating across two commercial divisions: **Yesode Enterprise** (for mid-market and large corporations) and **Yesode Business** (for growing SMBs), alongside **Yesode Labs** (100% free, ad-free engineering utilities).

- Official Domain: https://yesode.com ([Português](https://yesode.com/pt) | [English](https://yesode.com/en) | [Español](https://yesode.com/es))
- Full AI & Technical Reference: [llms-full.txt](https://yesode.com/llms-full.txt)
- Sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://yesode.com/sitemap.xml)
- GitHub: https://github.com/YesodeDF
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/yesode
- Contact: contato@yesode.com | dpo@yesode.com.br

## 1. Yesode Enterprise — Corporate Software Engineering & Critical Architecture

- [Enterprise (PT)](https://yesode.com/pt/enterprise): Consultoria de engenharia de software corporativa, arquitetura de sistemas críticos (DDD, Hexagonal, Event-Driven), modernização de sistemas legados (Strangler Fig), integração de alta vazão (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS) e engenharia de plataforma Cloud/Kubernetes com métricas DORA.
- [Enterprise (EN)](https://yesode.com/en/enterprise): Enterprise software engineering consultancy, mission-critical systems architecture, legacy monolith modernization, high-throughput ERP/CRM orchestration, and Cloud/Kubernetes platform engineering.
- [Enterprise (ES)](https://yesode.com/es/enterprise): Consultoría de ingeniería de software corporativa, arquitectura de sistemas críticos, modernización de legados e integración empresarial.

## 2. Yesode Business — SMB Process Automation, Applied AI & Custom Systems

- [Business (PT)](https://yesode.com/pt/business): Automação de processos empresariais, inteligência artificial aplicada com ROI, integração entre ERP e CRM e desenvolvimento de sistemas de gestão personalizados sem mensalidade por usuário.
- [Business (EN)](https://yesode.com/en/business): Business process automation, ROI-driven applied AI agents, bidirectional ERP/CRM integration, and custom business management systems.
- [Business (ES)](https://yesode.com/es/business): Automatización de procesos empresariales, inteligencia artificial aplicada, integración ERP/CRM y sistemas de gestión a medida.

## 3. Audited Case Studies & Technical Insights

- [Estudos de Caso & Insights (PT)](https://yesode.com/pt/cases): Metodologia verificável dos cases (-62% lead time em Fintech LATAM, 6,6x mais velocidade em Healthtech BR, -93% cancelamentos em Retail Omnichannel) e guias técnicos de decisão.
- [Case Studies & Insights (EN)](https://yesode.com/en/case-studies): Documented engineering case studies with baseline/after telemetry and architectural decision guides.
- [Casos de Estudio e Insights (ES)](https://yesode.com/es/casos-de-estudio): Casos de estudio documentados con telemetría antes/después y guías de arquitectura.
